design.purpose: Chunky two-tone storage basket for one person to hold yarn, toys or bedside things. Uses both balls: green base and lower sides, blue upper sides.

steps.c: Place green yarn, blue yarn and hook together
Magic ring, 6 single crochet, then 12 stitches
Work Rnd 3 to 18, Rnd 4 to 24, Rnd 5 to 30
Work 3 rounds of 30 single crochet in green
Cut green, join blue, work 3 rounds of 30
Cut blue, fasten off, weave in all tails
